key_insight: TextSeal2 strengthens distortion-free LLM watermark detection while preserving output diversity, speculative-decoding acceptance rates, and the target output distribution.
engineering_relevance: It supports watermarking in accelerated LLM generation without post-logits optimization or measurable added inference latency in the reported evaluation.
method: Merge multiple watermark keys into one virtual key rather than selecting a key by coin flip.
Couple the virtual key to fresh noise through AutoMark’s Gaussian copula.
Verify speculative drafts with an additional exponential race on leftover draft races, exploiting memorylessness to preserve exact target sampling.
evidence_signal: Across three LLMs at a false-positive rate of 10^-3, TextSeal2 improves detection over TextSeal by 8–22 percentage points for 100-token answers at equal diversity; under speculative decoding, it beats TextSeal and textGrain by 18 and 22 points, respectively, for 200-token answers at the same acceptance rate.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish robustness to paraphrasing or other adversarial edits, so deployment should test these conditions separately.
paper_title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
